messages:
sre-bot: INCIDENT detected: elevated 5xx rate (api-gateway) in us-east-1. Alert threshold exceeded (5m rolling).
ops-oncall: seeing a spike in 502/504s and timeouts. Dashboard shows prefix-kv miss rate +400% on shard-7.
alex: confirming -- key-prefetch latency jumps at ~11:03 UTC, then broad tail latency. Could be TTL/entropy in prefix cache.
jamie: @alex can you share query patterns? any hotspotting?
alex: request histo: lots of short seq requests, many identical prefixes. suspect eviction storm + stale TTL metadata.
marta: customer-impact: multiple customers reporting failed chat completions, approx 18% of requests hitting gateway errors in us-east-1. CS trying to triage.
customer-success: got two enterprise tickets opened, both seeing timeouts on generation endpoints. Marking as "major".
ops-oncall: quick mitigation plan: 1) flip cache-preheat off for most routes, 2) enable bypass for affected shard, 3) throttle burst traffic from queueing layer. Rolling steps now.
jamie: +1 on bypass. I'll tag a canary and push a bypass rule to shard-7.
ops-oncall: running command: 
```bash
./infractl cache set-bypass --shard shard-7 --reason "eviction-ttl-entropy 5xx" --dry-run=false
```
ops-oncall: bypass applied. Monitoring.
sre-bot: Deploy started: bypass-rule apply to shard-7 (deploy-id d-2026-03-15-1110).
alex: logs after bypass: backend 5xx rate dropped from 18% -> 9% in 45s. latency p95 reduced but still elevated.
marta: customer-impact update: CS reports partial recovery for 1 big customer, others still intermittent.
jamie: next step: reduce prefetch concurrency and disable aggressive TTL refresh job on shard-7 to stop churn.
ops-oncall: running TTL job disable: 
```json
{"job":"ttl-refresh","shard":"shard-7","action":"disable","initiator":"ops-oncall"}
```
ops-oncall: TTL job stopped. Observing eviction counters.
alex: eviction rate dropping, KV checksum mismatches reported earlier are gone. Some stale index entries remain.
jamie: let's avoid full shard restarts; prefer targeted cache node restarts. I'll restart prefetchnode-7a only.
ops-oncall: restart prefetchnode-7a now.
deploy-bot: Restart queued for prefetchnode-7a. ETA 30s.
ops-oncall: prefetchnode-7a back up. Post-restart health OK. 5xx now ~3.5% and trending down.
marta: preparing customer comms: preliminary root cause note: cache TTL/entropy + eviction storm causing prefix KV misses and gateway timeouts; mitigations in progress.
customer-success: sending interim update to impacted customers now.
jamie: follow-up actions: 1) run targeted KV sanity sweep for shard-7, 2) tune default TTL skew to reduce entropy, 3) add circuit-breaker at gateway for repeated KV misses.
alex: captured diagnostic snippets: 
```text
[11:02:13] eviction_count shard-7: 124k
[11:03:01] kv-miss rate: 37%
[11:04:10] gateway 502 spikes correlating with eviction spikes
```

ops-oncall: handing off to night oncall: @jamie will take post-mitigation monitoring and followups, I'll join asynchronous for RCA.
jamie: taking handoff. I'll coordinate with research/infra for TTL tuning tomorrow. Adding runbook link: https://runbook.internal/redwood/cache-eviction-response
marta: tagging CS action items: follow up with affected customers tomorrow with timeline and workaround.
sre-bot: Incident severity set to SEV2.
ops-oncall: closing immediate pager loop. If 5xx rises above 7% re-open. Good work team :thumbsup:
jamie: filing postmortem ticket and assigning owners: infra (ttl tuning) / runtime (circuit-breaker) / cs (customer comms).
customer-success: thanks all — will keep customers posted.
